publication_time_range: 1800-01-01 through 2026-10-15 for four main searches; supplementary named sources separately traced and publication metadata reviewed
databases: PubMed via NCBI E-utilities (MEDLINE plus other PubMed records)
deduplication: Exact PMID main/supplement unions; DOI metadata checked for focused extraction. No pooled clinical samples; possible cohort overlap unresolved.
inclusion: Adult healthy/state-specific collecting lumen imaging or capacity research
Original pressure-volume, irrigation and outflow mechanism studies kept by population
Wrong-population/compartment sources retained explicitly as exclusion comparators
exclusion_from_patient_endpoint_calibrat: Animal, child, obstructed or ex-vivo endpoints without transfer evidence
Diameter/grade, whole organ volume, drinking or input volume substituted for D2 capacity
No verifiable data or endpoint coverage
review_method: Single Codex-assisted structured focused review; all titles triaged, selected sources extracted with access scope. No claim of exhaustive dual-screened systematic review, PRISMA eligibility study or meta-analysis.
limits: Title/abstract synonyms may miss methods papers; citation chasing partly addresses this
Paywalls and recaptcha restrict full-text access; missing tables never reconstructed
Current retrieval is a dated snapshot, not a guarantee that all global studies were identified
PubMed ID deduplication is not proof of independent participants
copyright: Primary full texts are ignored local reading caches; metadata/provenance and our extraction retained. No paper figures digitized or adapted, no raw participant dataset obtained.
